status: pre-registered after smokes (Pythia-410m block 6 and Qwen2.5-0.5B block 12, 40 prompts, 512 neurons), before the full runs
question: Gemini 4's fusion of the essay's readout-honesty marks (a neuron moves only the next readout, or the final one beyond a matched null) and its Poe neuron (most of its effect indirect): which neurons speak directly, which route through later blocks, and which move their own block's readout only to be washed out?
design: e568's 280 prompts at the last position; every MLP neuron of Pythia-410m blocks 2, 6, 12, 17, 22 and of Qwen2.5-0.5B and its Instruct model at blocks 3, 12, 21; local effect = KL of a least-squares affine lens readout (block residual to final residual, fitted on 16,320 wikitext positions) when the write is removed; direct = KL at the output with the write subtracted from the final residual; total = KL with the neuron zeroed and every later block recomputed (prefix cached); nulls = random directions with the write's norm (95th percentile, 16 directions at 8 norms per prompt, interpolated); per neuron the KL summed over prompts against the null summed over prompts. Species: direct speaker (beyond the total null, direct at least half of total), indirect router (beyond the total null, direct under half), washed-out (beyond the local null, not the total), quiet.

hypotheses.S1: at Pythia-410m block 12, more than half of the neurons beyond the total-effect null are indirect routers
hypotheses.S2: the share of direct speakers among Pythia-410m neurons beyond the total null rises with depth: at block 22 it exceeds block 2's by at least 0.2
hypotheses.S3: at every Pythia-410m block, washed-out writers are at least 10% of the neurons beyond the local null
hypotheses.S4: fine-tuning keeps species: at Qwen2.5-0.5B blocks 3, 12 and 21, fewer than 10% of the neurons beyond the total null in either the base or the Instruct model change species between them
